value.rationale: Provides an exact all-coefficient enumeration and all extremizer counts for an unrestricted two-parameter family of strongly connected regular vertex-transitive digraphs. The binary-colouring phase when m is even and d odd contrasts the classical odd directed-cycle obstruction, and fractional optimum has a sharp parity law. The result supplies an explicit benchmark for contemporary general fractional majority-colouring bounds; these structural distinctions are not just renaming or a one-off tiny numerical improvement.
